name: PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk
summary: PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk engages in the hospital management of EMC Hospital Pulomas in Pulomas, East Jakarta. The company operates specialty centers. It also is involved in trading of medical equipment; healthcare pharmacy; real estate; and agriculture. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk.
